messages:
maria: quick PSA — our sampleapp used httpx.AsyncClient(auth=SyncAuth()) and CI started seeing 'Event loop is closed' during uvicorn reloads. repro below.

leo: can you paste minimal repro and error trace?

maria: gist: SyncAuth.auth_flow calls requests.post() to fetch token. works locally but flakes under reload/test teardown: RuntimeError: Event loop is closed.

jin: yep using sync I/O inside async client is risky. httpx lets you implement sync or async auth flows which confuses people.

leo: short-term: convert token fetch to async and implement async_auth_flow or run sync code in threadpool. long-term: SDK should accept token_provider that can be sync or async and we handle it. also throw a runtime warning if raw sync httpx.Auth is passed to AsyncClient.

maria: made async_auth_flow and it reduced failures, but still saw edge-case crashes when shutdown raced a token refresh.

jin: file an issue with a small pytest + uvicorn repro using MockTransport to emulate slow token endpoint. also add sampleapp README note.

ci-bot: Issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/issues/1544 (async-auth-deadlock)

maria: thanks — I'll attach CI logs and a tiny test case.
